note: Bare fetch() call sites with a non-constant URL. Seeded from the state on 2026-08-10 so the gate can only ratchet down. A new one must either use safeFetch (utils/url-validator.ts) or be added here with a reason. The federation entries are the documented carve-out. FULLY TRIAGED 2026-09-13: every entry now says what makes that call site right, and none carries the seeding placeholder any more. Two calls were moved rather than cleared (the work-expiry webhook, which fired a caller-supplied callback_url with no redirect re-validation, and the work forward to a remote node, which validated one hop and then followed any number), and eighteen entries were deleted because the scanner learned to skip comments on 2026-08-15 and nobody re-read the file afterwards: they pointed at prose. Adding an entry means writing what a reader can check, and it answers ONE question: can a low-privilege principal steer this address. Re-seeding forgives the whole file and is the developer's decision, never maintenance. 2026-10-16: ten entries still stood for calls that had since moved to safeFetch (openrouter.ts, admin-monitoring.ts, policy-book.ts) or for a line that no longer exists (appdev-research.ts); they were deleted, and the gate now fails under --strict on an entry that matches no call site. One entry covers one call: a second identical line in the same file is keyed "<key> #2".
